details: Bitcoin dropped sharply to $59,023 overnight on June 25, 2026, marking its lowest point since October 2024, before a slight recovery. This significant decline triggered nearly $1 billion in liquidations across the crypto market, with over $780 million from long positions. Analysts warn that a sustained break below $58,000 could lead to a further "cascade" in prices, potentially pushing Bitcoin to the $54,000-$56,000 range.
title: Bitcoin Plunges Below $60K Amid $1B Liquidations

details: The Ethereum Foundation is undergoing a significant restructuring, which includes a 40% reduction in its budget and the cutting of 54 roles. This strategic shift aims to move the organization towards long-term capital management, marking a "post-Foundation era" for Ethereum's governance and development.
title: Ethereum Foundation Cuts Staff & Budget in Major Restructure

details: Aave (AAVE) experienced a notable price surge, gaining over 9-14% in the past 24 hours. This positive movement follows Standard Chartered's initiation of coverage, which included a bullish projection that the AAVE token could reach $3,500 by 2030. This optimistic outlook has fueled strong investor demand and sentiment.
title: Aave (AAVE) Surges on Bullish Analyst Forecast

details: The future of cryptocurrency regulation in the United States faces increased uncertainty due to President Donald Trump's refusal to sign a bipartisan housing bill that included a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) ban. Trump's demand for his "Save America Act" to pass first jeopardizes the crucial bipartisan Clarity Act, creating ongoing regulatory ambiguity for the US crypto market.
title: US Crypto Regulatory Uncertainty Amidst Political Deadlock

details: Europol spearheaded "Operation Endgame," a global law enforcement effort that resulted in the freezing of over €41 million ($47 million) in criminal crypto assets. The operation successfully dismantled the infrastructure of three major malware families—SocGholish, Amadey, and StealC—which were used to steal passwords and cryptocurrency wallet data from infected systems.
title: Europol Operation Freezes $47M Criminal Crypto, Dismantles Malware

details: According to 21Shares' mid-year crypto market report released on June 24, 2026, Bitcoin is projected to recover towards $100,000 by the end of 2026, despite recent market fluctuations. The report also highlighted that crypto Exchange-Traded Product (ETP) assets under management stand at approximately $140 billion, with 1.25 million BTC currently held within ETP structures.
title: 21Shares Forecasts Bitcoin Recovery to $100K by End of 2026
